skills.name: best-practices
should_trigger: Review this Inttegro API integration for production-safe authentication, idempotency, pagination, and logging.
should_not_trigger: Show me today's merchant sales totals and the orders that need attention.
ambiguous: Help me make our first Inttegro integration reliable before launch.

skills.name: checkout
should_trigger: Implement hosted Inttegro Checkout and verify payment after the success redirect.
should_not_trigger: Create a hosted buy link for this already published product and active price.
ambiguous: Our customer needs a secure way to pay for this product.

skills.name: collect-unpaid-orders
should_trigger: Find all payment-pending orders, let me choose which customers to contact, and reconcile the results.
should_not_trigger: Take payment for this one order using the customer's selected saved method.
ambiguous: Help me recover revenue from orders that have not been paid.

skills.name: customer-care
should_trigger: Find this customer, review their recent commerce activity, and send one consented SMS.
should_not_trigger: Investigate this customer's failed payment and refund the affected line item.
ambiguous: A customer needs help with their account and recent order.

skills.name: daily-brief
should_trigger: Give me a numbers-first morning brief with sales, balances, payouts, top products, and exceptions.
should_not_trigger: Explain why this specific payout failed and reconcile it to balance transactions.
ambiguous: How is the business doing and what needs my attention?

skills.name: debug
should_trigger: Diagnose why our Inttegro MCP OAuth flow returns an insufficient-scope error after consent.
should_not_trigger: Connect Inttegro MCP to my coding agent for the first time.
ambiguous: Our Inttegro integration does not work in production.

skills.name: files
should_trigger: Upload this selected invoice attachment, create a customer-facing link, and later revoke it.
should_not_trigger: Send the finalized order invoice to its saved customer.
ambiguous: I need to share a document with a customer securely.

skills.name: fulfill-and-close
should_trigger: Find paid orders that are still incomplete, let me confirm fulfillment, complete them, and send receipts.
should_not_trigger: Cancel this unpaid order and explain whether a refund will happen.
ambiguous: Clear the orders that have already been fulfilled.

skills.name: integration
should_trigger: Choose the right Inttegro API, SDK, Checkout, and MCP surfaces and build our first end-to-end workflow.
should_not_trigger: Upgrade our existing Inttegro TypeScript SDK and remove deprecated calls.
ambiguous: Help us add Inttegro to our application.

skills.name: launch-offer
should_trigger: Create a new service product and price, publish it, and make a hosted buy link after I approve each term.
should_not_trigger: Create another buy link for this existing published product and active price.
ambiguous: I want to start selling a new consulting package.

skills.name: mcp
should_trigger: Configure the remote Inttegro MCP server in this agent host and handle OAuth and confirmation capabilities.
should_not_trigger: Diagnose a validation error from a direct Inttegro HTTP API request.
ambiguous: Build an agent that can work with our Inttegro account.

skills.name: message-templates
should_trigger: Draft, preview, publish, and send a reusable order-ready email template to one saved customer.
should_not_trigger: Send a one-off consented SMS to this existing customer.
ambiguous: We need a reusable customer notification for order updates.

skills.name: order-desk
should_trigger: Show the latest state of this order, then send its finalized invoice to the saved customer.
should_not_trigger: Charge this order using the second masked saved payment method.
ambiguous: Help me deal with this order and keep the customer informed.

skills.name: payment-refund
should_trigger: Show masked payment choices for this order, charge the selected method, and reconcile the result.
should_not_trigger: List payment-pending orders and let me decide which customers should receive a reminder.
ambiguous: The customer says the payment is wrong and wants money back.

skills.name: reconciliation
should_trigger: Explain the difference between our available balance, balance transactions, and this failed payout.
should_not_trigger: Give me a broad daily performance summary across orders, products, customers, and messages.
ambiguous: Where is our money and why has it not reached the bank?

skills.name: resolve-customer-case
should_trigger: Investigate this customer's order, failed payment, messages, and refund options, then apply the resolution I choose.
should_not_trigger: Update this customer's display name and send one routine consented SMS.
ambiguous: Own this customer complaint through investigation and resolution.

skills.name: sell-by-link
should_trigger: Create a single-use buy link for this existing published product and active price, then send it to the saved customer.
should_not_trigger: Create the new product and price before publishing an offer for the first time.
ambiguous: Give this customer a secure link to buy the product.

skills.name: shop
should_trigger: Find a locally made gift under fifty dollars, compare current options, and open secure checkout for the one I select.
should_not_trigger: Publish a merchant product and create a reusable buy link for it.
ambiguous: Can you help me find and buy a good running shoe?

skills.name: state-sync
should_trigger: Design bounded polling and idempotent reconciliation for pending Inttegro payment and refund states.
should_not_trigger: Investigate why our existing status poller is timing out in production.
ambiguous: Keep our application synchronized with Inttegro order changes.

skills.name: testing
should_trigger: Create contract, idempotency, failure-injection, checkout, and live end-to-end tests for this integration.
should_not_trigger: Find the root cause of this one failing Inttegro production request.
ambiguous: Make sure our Inttegro integration is ready for production.

skills.name: upgrade
should_trigger: Upgrade the Inttegro Go SDK, regenerate types, remove deprecated usage, and verify behavioral changes.
should_not_trigger: Implement our first Inttegro integration in a new application.
ambiguous: Bring this old Inttegro integration up to date safely.

agents.name: commerce-analyst
should_trigger: Delegate a read-only multi-source analysis of sales, balances, payouts, and message performance.
should_not_trigger: Create a product, price, and buy link for a new offer.
ambiguous: Have a specialist explain what changed across the business this week.

agents.name: customer-journey-investigator
should_trigger: Delegate a read-only trace across this customer's explicit order, message, product, price, and buy-link IDs.
should_not_trigger: Send a message and issue a refund to resolve this customer case.
ambiguous: Have a specialist reconstruct what happened to this customer without changing anything.

agents.name: customer-resolution-specialist
should_trigger: Delegate this one support case for investigation and the exact approved payment, message, or refund follow-up.
should_not_trigger: Analyze customer trends across the whole merchant account without changing records.
ambiguous: Have a specialist take this customer complaint through to a safe resolution.

agents.name: order-operations-manager
should_trigger: Delegate an order queue to amend drafts, finalize, send invoices, complete fulfilled orders, and send receipts.
should_not_trigger: Charge an order or create a line-item refund.
ambiguous: Have an operator clear the routine order work waiting today.

agents.name: sales-closer
should_trigger: Delegate one explicit customer opportunity through product selection, order or buy link, invoice, and approved payment attempt.
should_not_trigger: Send a marketing campaign to every customer in the account.
ambiguous: Have a specialist carry this qualified sale across the required Inttegro records.

overlap_cases.prompt: Set up a brand-new product and price, publish it, then create its first hosted buy link.
overlap_cases.reason: New commercial terms belong to offer setup, not routine buy-link lifecycle work.

overlap_cases.prompt: Create another hosted buy link for an existing published product and active price.
overlap_cases.reason: The product and price already exist, so only link lifecycle work is required.

overlap_cases.prompt: Investigate one customer's failed payment and messages, then refund the exact line I approve.
overlap_cases.reason: The request spans evidence and action across one support case rather than only payment execution.

overlap_cases.prompt: List unpaid orders, let me select the recovery candidates, and prepare approved follow-up actions.
overlap_cases.reason: This is a queue-level revenue recovery workflow, not a single-order charge.

overlap_cases.prompt: Implement hosted checkout and add contract, redirect, idempotency, and failure-recovery tests.
overlap_cases.reason: The request explicitly combines a checkout implementation with a test strategy.

overlap_cases.prompt: Find a published product for me to buy and open checkout after I select the exact option.
overlap_cases.reason: This is consumer discovery and purchase handoff, not merchant catalog or buy-link administration.

overlap_cases.prompt: Explain today's broad performance, then investigate why one returned payout failed.
overlap_cases.reason: The request contains both a business-wide brief and a focused money reconciliation.

overlap_cases.prompt: Configure Inttegro MCP in this host and diagnose why its OAuth connection is missing tool scopes.
overlap_cases.reason: Connection setup and evidence-led failure diagnosis are both explicitly requested.
